albedo-2k.processing: Resized to 2048×1024 and encoded as WebP (quality 88).
notes: LRO Wide Angle Camera mosaic taken with the Sun high over each area: it shows brightness (albedo), not the shadows seen near the terminator.
Polar gaps are filled from other LROC data in the source kit.

albedo-4k.processing: Resized to 4096×2048 and encoded as WebP (quality 88).
notes: LRO Wide Angle Camera mosaic taken with the Sun high over each area: it shows brightness (albedo), not the shadows seen near the terminator.
Polar gaps are filled from other LROC data in the source kit.

elevation-global.format: int16 little-endian, metres above the 1737.4 km reference sphere, row-major from the north-west corner
elevation-global.processing: Float kilometres converted to whole metres (int16). No resampling.
notes: LOLA laser altimetry gridded at 4 pixels per degree (about 7.6 km per pixel).

terrain-aristarchus-albedo.processing: Read by HTTP range; bilinear resampling to the same 384×384 grid as the elevation crop.
notes: Morphologic mosaic: images taken with the Sun at moderate angles, so relief shading is included.

terrain-aristarchus-dem.format: int16 little-endian, metres above the 1737.4 km reference sphere, N×N row-major from the north-west corner
terrain-aristarchus-dem.processing: Read 768 rows × 1319 columns by HTTP range; bilinear resampling to a 384×384 local grid (north up, 0.365 km per sample); raw values × 0.5 m.
notes: Source grid is about 118 m per pixel; smaller details are not in the data.
